verdict.rationale: Vanta's docs say its API covers evidence collection and testing for Mobile Device Managers (MDM), and the Auditor API lets you review the personnel and monitored computers in scope for an audit. Together these suggest per-employee device monitoring exists through MDM integration. However, none of the evidence names the specific workstation checks or describes a first-party device agent. Missing for 10: explicit disk-encryption, screen-lock and password-manager checks, documentation of a Vanta device agent, a per-employee device-compliance view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
